author: SberRoboticsCenter
description:
GreenChallengeData
	

Demonstrations of a bimanual humanoid robot performing manipulation tasks in simulation, for training vision-language-action (VLA) policies. The repository gathers five collections: three task-specific deliveries recorded by human teleoperation and augmented with synthetic trajectories, a large set of scripted-policy episodes covering 15 tasks, and the BenchMart store collection with four product-picking tasks.
Format: LeRobot v2.1 · 30 fps · 3 cameras… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/SberRoboticsCenter/GreenChallengeData.
